messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key navigation between cards, with row and column edge stops. Movement preserves the remembered tab stop and leaves modified arrow keys to the browser.

Verification passed: type checking, 138 unit and static tests, and all 76 browser tests, including keyboard play, focus scrolling, pointer and touch play.

The repository-wide formatting check still reports 13 unchanged files outside this fix. The changed files are formatted.
